headline: Multiple Critical Zero-Days Under Active Exploitation; Phishing Campaigns Bypass MFA
summary: This cybersecurity brief for September 8, 2026, covers a surge in actively exploited zero-day vulnerabilities affecting critical enterprise software. Adobe Commerce, N-able N-central, and MikroTik RouterOS are all under attack from unauthenticated remote code execution flaws, prompting emergency patches. Additionally, a new local privilege escalation zero-day in CrowdStrike's Falcon Sensor has been publicly disclosed. Threat actors continue to evolve, with a North Korean group backdooring HAProxy source code and sophisticated phishing campaigns using vishing and adversary-in-the-middle techniques to bypass MFA and steal Microsoft 365 session tokens. A new report also highlights how fragmented federal incident reporting rules are hampering response efforts in the U.S.

articles.headline: Researcher 'Nightmare Eclipse' Drops Three LPE Zero-Day Exploits
articles.title: Zero-Days in CrowdStrike, Avast, Nvidia Disclosed
articles.excerpt: A security researcher known as 'Nightmare Eclipse' has publicly released proof-of-concept exploits for three unpatched local privilege escalation (LPE) zero-day vulnerabilities. The flaws, named 'FalconFlank', 'PrettyPrague', and 'GreenSection', affect CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor, Avast Antivirus, and Nvidia components, respectively. Each exploit allows a local attacker to gain SYSTEM-level privileges. CrowdStrike has issued interim guidance, while Avast's parent company reports a fix has been deployed.
articles.updateSummary: New technical analysis for 'FalconFlank' LPE in CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor, including MITRE ATT&CK techniques and specific hunting indicators.
articles.updateContent: This update provides a deeper technical analysis of the 'FalconFlank' local privilege escalation vulnerability affecting CrowdStrike Falcon Sensor. It details the exploit's mechanism, mapping it to MITRE ATT&CK techniques such as T1068 (Privilege Escalation) and T1548.002 (Bypass UAC). New hunting hints are included, focusing on monitoring `CSFalconService.exe` for unexpected DLL loads from non-standard paths, file writes to `C:\Windows\Temp\`, and unusual child processes (Event ID 4688). The interim mitigation remains disabling the 'Office malicious macros remediation' policy.

articles.headline: N-able N-central Hit by Actively Exploited CVSS 10.0 RCE Flaw
articles.title: N-able N-central CVSS 10.0 RCE (CVE-2026-86218)
articles.excerpt: N-able is urging on-premises customers to immediately apply an emergency hotfix for its N-central RMM platform to address a critical, actively exploited zero-day. The vulnerability, CVE-2026-86218, is a pre-authentication RCE with a 10.0 CVSS score. It allows unauthenticated attackers to gain full control of N-central servers, creating a severe supply chain risk for MSPs and their clients. This is the fourth emergency patch N-able has issued in five weeks for its RMM product.
articles.updateSummary: New details on N-able N-central RCE (CVE-2026-86218) include specific IP range for active exploitation and MITRE ATT&CK mapping.
articles.updateContent: Further analysis of the N-able N-central RCE (CVE-2026-86218) reveals that active exploitation was observed by Huntress labs targeting the platform's API as early as September 4, 2026. N-able has also identified scanning and exploitation activity originating from the IP range 23.234.64.0/18. This new information provides critical Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) for defenders to scan their logs and network traffic. Additionally, the report maps observed and inferred attacker techniques to MITRE ATT&CK, including T1190 (Exploit Public-Facing Application) for initial access and T1078.001 (Default Accounts) for persistence, offering a clearer picture of the attack methodology.

articles.headline: Unpatched 'StyleSmuggler' RCE Flaw Hits Magento & Adobe Commerce
articles.title: StyleSmuggler RCE Hits Magento, Adobe Commerce
articles.excerpt: An unpatched, unauthenticated RCE zero-day vulnerability named 'StyleSmuggler' is being actively exploited to compromise e-commerce sites running Magento Open Source and Adobe Commerce. Discovered by Sansec, the attack leverages the GraphQL endpoint and the template system to inject a backdoor. The flaw affects all current versions, including fully patched instances. With no official patch available, administrators are urged to disable GraphQL if unused and scan for compromise.
articles.updateSummary: Adobe released an emergency patch (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) for the 'StyleSmuggler' RCE zero-day, urging immediate application.
articles.updateContent: Adobe has released an emergency security update for the 'StyleSmuggler' RCE zero-day, now officially tracked as CVE-2026-75650 with a critical CVSS score of 10.0. The patch addresses the unauthenticated remote code execution vulnerability affecting Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source. Exploitation, which began on September 4, 2026, has been observed originating from IP addresses in China and Romania. Administrators are strongly advised to apply the patch immediately to mitigate the risk of compromise and to investigate for signs of active exploitation.

articles.headline: MikroTik Routers Hijacked via 'MikroTrick' Unauthenticated Exploit
articles.title: MikroTik Routers Under Attack via SSH Flaws
articles.excerpt: Attackers are actively exploiting an unauthenticated exploit chain called 'MikroTrick' to gain full administrative control of MikroTik routers with SSH exposed to the internet. The attack, observed by CERT Polska since at least September 2, combines an SSH authentication bypass (CVE-2026-67276) and a privilege escalation flaw (CVE-2026-86060). MikroTik has released patches for RouterOS, and administrators are urged to update immediately and check for signs of compromise, such as a user named 'ops'.
articles.updateSummary: New technical analysis, MITRE ATT&CK mapping, and enhanced hunting hints for the MikroTrick exploit chain. Detailed privilege escalation mechanism and additional mitigation strategies provided.
articles.updateContent: This update provides a deeper technical analysis of the 'MikroTrick' exploit chain, detailing how the privilege escalation (CVE-2026-86060) manipulates the RouterOS policy mask for full admin rights. It also maps the attack to MITRE ATT&CK techniques, including Initial Access (T1190), Privilege Escalation (T1068), Persistence (T1136.001), and Defense Evasion (T1070.006). New 'Cyber Observables' offer specific hunting hints for compromise detection, such as auditing user accounts, log analysis for '/system script add', and suspicious DNS requests. Additionally, 'IP Allowlisting' for SSH access is recommended as an enhanced mitigation, and factory reset is emphasized for suspected compromises.

articles.headline: North Korean Hackers Implant Backdoor Directly into HAProxy Source Code
articles.title: North Korea-Linked Group Hides 'ted backdoor' in HAProxy Software
articles.excerpt: A North Korea-linked threat actor has been observed targeting South Korean automotive and media companies with a novel Linux toolkit. The campaign's most sophisticated element is a backdoor, dubbed 'ted backdoor,' which is compiled directly into the source code of the widely-used HAProxy load-balancing software. By integrating as a custom plugin using HAProxy's native APIs, the implant evades traditional detection methods while intercepting HTTP traffic, executing commands, and harvesting credentials. The broader toolkit also includes trojanized versions of common Linux daemons like crond and sshd, enabling long-term persistence and surveillance within compromised networks.

articles.headline: 'BigBear 2.0' Phishing Service Bypasses MFA in Global M365 Campaign
articles.title: 'BigBear 2.0' PhaaS Targets Microsoft 365 Users with MFA Bypass
articles.excerpt: A large-scale phishing-as-a-service (PhaaS) operation, named 'BigBear 2.0,' is targeting hundreds of organizations globally with Microsoft 365 credential theft attacks. Researched by CloudSEK, the service uses a customized version of the Evilginx2 adversary-in-the-middle (AiTM) framework to bypass multi-factor authentication (MFA) and steal session cookies. The operation, managed by an actor named 'General Boss,' has compromised over 5,000 records across 40+ countries. The framework uses advanced techniques like custom JavaScript to disable FIDO2/WebAuthn and residential proxies to evade detection. IT service providers and MSPs are primary targets, indicating a potential for supply chain attacks.

articles.headline: Fragmented Federal Rules Divert Resources from Cyber Incident Response
articles.title: Report: Fragmented Federal Cyber Reporting Rules Hinder US Response
articles.excerpt: A joint report by Auburn University’s McCrary Institute and the U.S. Chamber of Commerce warns that the current landscape of federal cyber incident reporting in the United States is dangerously fragmented. The report identifies 117 different regulations across 27 federal agencies, creating duplicative and conflicting burdens on private industry during a crisis. This forces organizations to divert critical personnel and resources away from active incident response to focus on compliance paperwork. The report advocates for a streamlined 'report once, use many times' model, anchored by CISA, to harmonize requirements and allow companies to focus on defense and recovery.
